attempts.summary: Built a double-NAT transit path: node3 (lan-a, 192.168.10.0/24) sends to node4 (lan-b, 192.168.30.0/24:8080); node1 (VyOS) SNATs the traffic to its transit IP 192.168.20.1 as it enters the transit network; node2 (OPNsense) SNATs it again to its lan-b IP 192.168.30.1 as it enters lan-b. node4 records every connection as arriving from node2 (192.168.30.1), never from node3 or node1's addresses. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all four nodes (node1 VyOS, node2 OPNsense/FreeBSD, node3/node4 CentOS Stream 10) one at a time, each showing a changed OS-native boot identity and full recovery of interfaces, NAT/firewall rules, routes, and the HTTP service; re-verified the full double-NAT path end-to-end after all restarts.
